name: The Genius Heiress 2
overview:
Top scholar Lin Si Wang has just started a company, ready to make a name for herself, when she encounters the even more outrageous main branch of the Su family. There is a possessive CEO entangled in dramatic romance, a reckless second young master living like an outlaw, and a sickly obsessive third young master who mistakes her for his benefactor. Everyone is obsessed with playing out over-the-top melodramatic scenarios, while no one actually takes work seriously.

How could someone trained through relentless academic rigor miss such a perfect opportunity? Watch as she takes on the domineering CEO, deals with the unruly young master, and builds her own business empire.
